import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn


class PositionalEncoding(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d_model, max_len=5000):
        super().__init__()
        pe = torch.zeros(max_len, d_model)
        position = torch.arange(0, max_len, dtype=torch.float).unsqueeze(1)
        div_term = torch.exp(
            torch.arange(0, d_model, 2).float() * (-math.log(10000.0) / d_model)
        )
        pe[:, 0::2] = torch.sin(position * div_term)
        pe[:, 1::2] = torch.cos(position * div_term)
        self.register_buffer("pe", pe.unsqueeze(0))

    def forward(self, x):
        return x + self.pe[:, : x.size(1)]


class RecoveredModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.embedding = nn.Linear(64, 128)
        self.pos_encoder = PositionalEncoding(128)
        encoder_layer = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=128, nhead=8, dim_feedforward=256, batch_first=False
        )
        self.transformer_encoder = nn.TransformerEncoder(encoder_layer, num_layers=3)
        decoder_layer = nn.TransformerDecoderLayer(
            d_model=128, nhead=8, dim_feedforward=256, batch_first=False
        )
        self.transformer_decoder = nn.TransformerDecoder(decoder_layer, num_layers=1)
        self.output_layer = nn.Linear(128, 64)

    def forward(self, src, tgt):
        src = self.pos_encoder(self.embedding(src))
        tgt = self.pos_encoder(self.embedding(tgt))
        memory = self.transformer_encoder(src)
        decoded = self.transformer_decoder(tgt, memory)
        return self.output_layer(decoded)


def main():
    weights = torch.load("/app/weights.pt", map_location="cpu")
    data = torch.load("/app/dataset.pt", map_location="cpu")
    src, tgt = data["src_sequences"], data["tgt_sequences"]

    model = RecoveredModel()
    model.load_state_dict(weights, strict=True)
    model.eval()

    with torch.no_grad():
        original_loss = nn.functional.mse_loss(model(src, tgt), tgt).item()

    for p in model.parameters():
        p.requires_grad_(False)

    with torch.no_grad():
        features = model.transformer_decoder(
            model.pos_encoder(model.embedding(tgt)),
            model.transformer_encoder(model.pos_encoder(model.embedding(src))),
        )
    X = features.reshape(-1, features.shape[-1]).double()
    Y = tgt.reshape(-1, tgt.shape[-1]).double()
    X = torch.cat([X, torch.ones(X.shape[0], 1, dtype=X.dtype)], dim=1)
    solution = torch.linalg.lstsq(X, Y).solution
    with torch.no_grad():
        model.output_layer.weight.copy_(
            solution[:-1].T.to(model.output_layer.weight.dtype)
        )
        model.output_layer.bias.copy_(solution[-1].to(model.output_layer.bias.dtype))

    with torch.no_grad():
        new_loss = nn.functional.mse_loss(model(src, tgt), tgt).item()

    print(f"original_loss={original_loss:.10f}")
    print(f"new_loss={new_loss:.10f}")

    scripted = torch.jit.script(model)
    torch.jit.save(scripted, "/app/model.pt")

    loaded = torch.jit.load("/app/model.pt", map_location="cpu")
    loaded.load_state_dict(weights, strict=True)
    with torch.no_grad():
        check_original = nn.functional.mse_loss(loaded(src, tgt), tgt).item()
    loaded.load_state_dict(model.state_dict(), strict=True)
    with torch.no_grad():
        check_new = nn.functional.mse_loss(loaded(src, tgt), tgt).item()
    print(f"scripted_original_loss={check_original:.10f}")
    print(f"scripted_new_loss={check_new:.10f}")

    saved = torch.jit.load("/app/model.pt", map_location="cpu").state_dict()
    print("keys_match:", list(saved.keys()) == list(weights.keys()))
    diffs = [k for k in weights if not torch.equal(saved[k], weights[k])]
    print("changed_keys:", diffs)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
